expert_commentary: This DAG captures causal mechanisms: the age of the account influences the transaction behavior which in turn influences the probability of fraud. Contextual variables (location, device) interact before affecting the fraud.

liens.raison: A young account has less historical transactions
Time of transaction influences the transaction amount
Older accounts have a lower chance of large transactions
Device used depends on context (location, transaction amount)
Location influences the type of transaction
Historical fraudulent transactions indicate a higher chance of current fraud
Abnormal number of transactions in the last 24 hours is a signal of fraud
Anomalous transaction amount is a signal of fraud
